text_block_list.text: —A few days prior.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf, who just achieved the 
Double Crown in the Satsuki Sho and 
Japanese Derby the other day!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"She's an undefeated Double Crown 
Umamusume who won the Satsuki Sho in 
record time and showed off an incredible 
final spurt in the Japanese Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Following Mr. C.B. last year, another 
formidable Umamusume has appeared!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Compared to Mr. C.B., one doesn't 
sense that free-spirited boldness, but—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Her stability and strength are simply 
exceptional! She pushes forward to secure 
a good position, paces herself mid-race, 
and then finishes strong with a solid 
final spurt.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
She truly runs races worthy of a rightful 
champion. If Mr. C.B. is "incredible," 
then perhaps Symboli Rudolf is 
"invincible."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Truly "strong," Symboli Rudolf! Will she 
take the Kikuka Sho just like this?! 
Expectations for a Triple Crown Umamusume 
are soaring!

The public was buzzing with rumors about 
the birth of the next Triple Crown 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—...Alright! Preparations are perfect. 
Looks like I'll be able to enjoy the 
Takarazuka Kinen, too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that really was something. The 
excitement surrounding Rudolf lately, I 
mean."

Setting aside today's Takarazuka Kinen 
itself... the recent wave of excitement 
has been truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The methods, the results... All wrapped 
together, that's just so like you, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Will we clash somewhere? Maybe the 
year-end Arima Kinen... With this kind of 
popularity, she's bound to run, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right? ...Hehe, now I have even more to 
look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
With Ace around too, I'm truly blessed 
with great rivals.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I won at the Fan Appreciation Festival. 
And the distance ain't that different, 
either.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...! Alright!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Today is mine for the taking. And I'm 
gonna show the whole world...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The one shattering common sense... is 
Katsuragi Ace... got that?!

Amidst a swirl of diverse fighting 
spirits— the curtain rises on the 
Takarazuka Kinen!
